#### ADDENDUM: clean regressions (regone24.py, post-main) ####
Why: the in-process reg24 calls in phases 4-5 are NOT
comparable. sim1017/sim1018 build their worlds from the
GLOBAL random module (random.seed(20261127) at import, then
sim1019.py:78 re-seeds 20261128 at import — the last seed
wins), and each build_world()/build_world_device() call
consumes global RNG state. Consequences:
  (a) every reg24 call builds DIFFERENT v6/sim1018 worlds
      (phase-4 valve-OFF reg, phase-4 valve-ON reg and phase-5
      FINAL reg each measured a different world);
  (b) reg24 caches the sim1018 OLD run in _REG24_OLD, so calls
      2+ compare NEW-on-world-N against OLD-on-world-1 — the
      phase-4 valve-ON (9.4%) and phase-5 FINAL (9.7%) sim1018
      numbers are cross-world and INVALID as stated. The v6
      comparison inside one reg24 call IS valid (old/new share
      the world built in that call), so phase-4 valve-OFF v6
      PASS and phase-5 FINAL v6 FAIL are both real — but on
      different worlds.
Method (regone24.py, kept in this directory): ONE reg24 call
per fresh process, global RNG seeded explicitly with
20261127+k before the call, so OLD and NEW share the same
worlds. Final spec BaSent+Bb, k = 0,1,2, valve ON/OFF.
Canonical world = k=1 (post-import seed 20261128): it
reproduces s23's OLD baseline exactly (sim1018 OLD 8.3%,
v6 PASS) and matches phase-4's first (valid) reg call
(valve-OFF 8.6%).
REGONE k=0 valve=ON : v6 FAIL, sim1018 FAIL (NEW 12.2% vs OLD 11.1%)
REGONE k=0 valve=OFF: v6 FAIL, sim1018 PASS (NEW 10.4% vs OLD 11.1%)
REGONE k=1 valve=ON : v6 PASS, sim1018 FAIL (NEW  9.5% vs OLD  8.3%)
REGONE k=1 valve=OFF: v6 PASS, sim1018 FAIL (NEW  8.6% vs OLD  8.3%)
REGONE k=2 valve=ON : v6 FAIL, sim1018 PASS (NEW  6.8% vs OLD  7.7%)
REGONE k=2 valve=OFF: v6 FAIL, sim1018 PASS (NEW  6.6% vs OLD  7.7%)
v6 failure anatomy: k=0 — OLD fresh-hold median itself is
4146 ms (gate bar NEW<300 is unpassable on that world; NEW
3833 < OLD 4146, pairs 2 vs OLD 5); k=2 — fresh-hold 7->7 and
line-start 460->459 both pass, only pairs/60s 2 vs OLD 4
fails. The variant never makes v6 line-start or fresh-hold
worse than OLD on any seed. v6 verdict is world-dependent:
1/3 PASS for both valve settings.
sim1018: the OLD baseline itself varies 7.7-11.1% by world —
the "8.3% cap" is one world's OLD, not a constant. Valve-OFF
beats valve-ON on dropped audio on all 3 seeds (10.4 vs 12.2,
8.6 vs 9.5, 6.6 vs 6.8). Canonical-world verdict for the
FINAL spec: v6 PASS; sim1018 FAIL (valve-ON 9.5%, valve-OFF
8.6% vs OLD 8.3%).
